text: I froze when my manager asked me to walk through my numbers, and now everyone thinks I don't know my own project.
A coworker presented my idea as theirs and I just nodded along.
My boss read my message two hours ago and hasn't replied. I keep checking.
Three weeks into the new job and I'm sure they've realised hiring me was a mistake.
Sunday afternoon and my chest is already tight about Monday.
I sent the client the wrong file. They didn't even notice but I can't stop replaying it.
Rent went up again and I did the math three times hoping it would come out different.
I said I wasn't hungry so I wouldn't have to split an expensive dinner with friends.
Everyone my age seems to own a place and I'm still saving for a deposit that keeps moving.
I bought something I didn't need to feel better and now I feel worse.
I had to ask my parents for money at 31 and I couldn't look at them while I did it.
I finally paid off my credit card today and I don't know what to do with how light I feel.
We had a great first date and now she's taking hours to reply. I've already decided it's over.
We had the same fight about the dishes again and it's never really about the dishes.
My ex just got engaged and I'm happy for him and also I want to throw my phone.
Another wedding invite with no plus one. I'm tired of being the single friend at every table.
I told him how I feel and he said I'm too much. Maybe I am.
We cooked dinner together tonight without our phones and I remembered why I love him.
My mom made one comment about my weight at lunch and it's all I can think about.
My brother is still the golden child and I'm still trying to earn a seat at the table.
My dad needed help getting up from the couch today and it scared me more than I showed.
I snapped at my kids over nothing tonight and they went quiet.
The holidays are coming and I'm already rehearsing how to avoid the same arguments.
My daughter read her first full book out loud to me tonight and I had to pretend I had something in my eye.
I saw photos from a party in the group chat that nobody invited me to.
I'm always the one who texts first. If I stopped, would anyone notice?
I said something awkward at a party three days ago and I still cringe every time I remember it.
My best friend from school and I barely talk anymore and I don't know whose fault it is.
I moved here a year ago and I still don't have anyone to call on a Saturday.
I cancelled on my friend again because I didn't have it in me, and I feel like a bad person.
I'm waiting on test results and my mind keeps writing the worst version.
It's 3am and I'm awake again thinking about everything I didn't do today.
I went to the gym and felt like everyone was watching me not know what I was doing.
My back hurts every day and people keep telling me to just stretch more.
I booked my first therapy appointment and now I want to cancel it.
I ran 5k without stopping for the first time. Slow, but the whole way.
I scrolled for an hour and now I feel like everyone is doing life better than me.
Someone complimented my work and I immediately listed everything wrong with it.
No matter what I get done in a day, it never feels like enough.
I caught my reflection in a shop window and spent the rest of the walk picking it apart.
I said no to an extra project and I've felt guilty about it all afternoon.
I'm 38 and only now figuring out what I actually like. It feels late.
Everyone asks what my five-year plan is and I don't even have a five-month one.
I want to change careers but starting over at 35 feels like admitting I wasted ten years.
I read the news about the climate and wonder what kind of world I'm planning for.
I graduate in two months and I have no idea what comes next.
I got the job abroad and now that it's real I'm terrified I'm making a mistake.
I don't know if I want kids and it feels like time is deciding for me.
I've lived here eight years and I still feel like a guest when people ask where I'm really from.
My parents' language is slipping away from me and I feel like I'm losing a part of them.
I got laid off and realised I don't know who I am when nobody asks what I do.
Since the baby came I love her completely and I miss who I used to be.
I came out to my oldest friend today. It went fine and I'm still shaking.
I've always been 'the quiet one' and I'm tired of being treated like I have nothing to say.
It would have been my dad's birthday today. I picked up my phone to call him before I remembered.
We had to put our dog down this week and the house is too quiet.
My friend has cancer and I don't know what to say to her, so I keep saying nothing.
We lost the pregnancy last month and everyone has moved on except me.
We sold my grandma's house after she died and I didn't get to say goodbye to the kitchen.
I keep reading about the war and the children there and feel useless living my normal day.
